note: Hangar launch budgets in fictional Kc (CostModel.FormatKc units), per destination orbit. Over budget is a hard launch block (Poly Bridge / DECISIONS #100): the pad names how far over and Launch stays off until the quote fits. A design may carry its own budgetKc (a mission sets it); otherwise the orbit row, then defaultKc. nearFraction starts the 'getting close' note.
